## Added
- Server written in Rust for Proxmox, Linux (x64 and ARM), Docker and Windows: music library scan, upload, streaming with seeking, users, playlists, likes and history
- Recommendations: personal mix, radio from any song, smart shuffle, similar songs (learns from plays, skips and likes)
- Web app with German and English, dark design with three accent colours
- Android app with background playback, notification and lock screen controls
- Desktop app built with Tauri for Windows (setup) and Linux (AppImage), media keys supported
- Proxmox installer that creates the container and prints the address

## Fixed
- Nothing yet, first release

## Install
- **Server (Proxmox node shell):** `bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Labtoso/Musik/main/deploy/proxmox.sh)"`
- **Android:** install `Musik.apk`, enter the server address
- **Windows:** run `Musik.exe`, enter the server address
- **Linux:** `chmod +x Musik.AppImage && ./Musik.AppImage`
- **Debian / Ubuntu server:** `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Labtoso/Musik/main/deploy/install.sh | sudo bash`
- **Server only:** `musik-server-linux-x64`, `musik-server-linux-arm64` or `musik-server-windows-x64.exe`
